purpose: Teach: ６つ/ミソ/外野/ヤミ/タネ/キズ/オジサン/くず

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、コンビニで肉まん６つ買ってたな
lines.en: Riku — I saw you buying six meat buns at the convenience store.
lines.style: Light, teasing observation. Quick rhythm. A smile in the voice. Not mean, just noticing something she finds funny about him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ミソカツ好きだったよな、桜
lines.en: You were into miso katsu, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Turning it back on her. Calm, steady. A gentle counter-tease. He's been paying attention too. Slight warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、サッカーで外野席から応援してたな
lines.en: Riku — you were out in the bleachers cheering at soccer practice.
lines.style: Curious observation, slightly amused. Slower pace. Testing the water. Voice softens on her noticing him noticing her.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、漫画の「ヤミ落ち」展開語ってたろ、桜
lines.en: You were going on about that 'dark descent' manga plot, remember, Sakura?
lines.style: Dry, almost teasing back. Light rhythm. Not defensive — more like he's playing the same game. A small smile underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、向日葵のタネを蒔いてたな
lines.en: Riku — you were planting sunflower seeds.
lines.style: Quieter observation. Slower, more deliberate. Voice carries a tenderness she probably doesn't expect. Choosing to bring up something small and specific.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ヒザのキズだらけでサッカー帰って来たろ、桜
lines.en: You came back from soccer with your knees scraped up all the time, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Wry, matter-of-fact. Quick delivery. But underneath — he was worried about those scrapes. The teasing covers something softer.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のオジサン、面白いってクラスで話題だぞ
lines.en: Riku — your uncle is the topic of conversation in class. Everyone thinks he's hilarious.
lines.style: Light tease. Slight laugh on the edges. Not cruel — genuinely amused. The kind of thing friends bring up because they know you can take it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、模試の結果見て「くず点数」って自虐してたな、桜
lines.en: You were beating yourself up about your mock exam score, called it 'garbage points' or something.
lines.style: Wry, gentle. Closer delivery — intimate. He's catching her in her own self-criticism. Not to hurt her, but to reflect it back. Warm underneath.
